sources.title: Kafka design
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Apache Flink：event time、watermark 與遲到資料
related.titleEn: Apache Flink: event time,watermarks and late data
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以亂序事件建立 tumbling window，追蹤 watermark 如何界定完成與遲到。
related.differenceEn: Build tumbling windows from out-of-order events and trace completion and lateness via watermarks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 教學基準：5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect；第二檢核：5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Watermark 是來源對 event-time 進度的宣告，非證明永遠不會有更舊資料；遲到處置需明訂。 教學基準：13-3 = 10 watermark after event 13；第二檢核：floor(13/10)*10 = 10 event-13 window start。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. Teaching baseline: 5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect; second check: 5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A watermark is a source progress declaration,not proof that older events can never arrive; late-data handling is explicit. Teaching baseline: 13-3 = 10 watermark after event 13; second check: floor(13/10)*10 = 10 event-13 window start. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Redis sorted set：排行榜、同分與區間
related.titleEn: Redis sorted sets: leaderboards,ties and ranges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以唯一 member 與 score 建排行，確認更新分數不會新增第二筆同 member。
related.differenceEn: Build a leaderboard of unique members and scores and verify updating one member does not duplicate it.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 教學基準：5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect；第二檢核：5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Sorted set 的 member 唯一而 score 可相同；同分次序遵循系統定義，需與產品排名政策分開。 教學基準：90+15 = 105 B updated score；第二檢核：4 = 4 unique members。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. Teaching baseline: 5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect; second check: 5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Members are unique while scores may tie; system tie ordering is distinct from product ranking policy. Teaching baseline: 90+15 = 105 B updated score; second check: 4 = 4 unique members. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
